prompt: One single continuous take from a low locked-off camera in a dark early-spring Hokkaido mountain forest at dusk: no cuts, no scene change. An adult male brown bear on all fours advances slowly step by step straight toward the camera out of the gloom, head dropped low, eyes fixed on the lens, fangs bared, the fur along its neck bristled, until its head and shoulders fill most of the frame. Thin mist drifts between the bare trees. Dark but NOT pure black, the bear stays clearly readable. The forest is empty apart from the bear. 8 seconds. Photorealistic, shot on RED camera. Documentary style.
